subject.title: [Bug]: restart storm from telegram.retry.jitter type mismatch + misleading doctor SecretRef for Telegram token

question: After the linked retry-jitter migration is resolved, should this issue remain the umbrella tracker for SecretRef, CDP, and multi-runtime hardening, or should those leftovers be split into focused follow-ups?
rationale: The jitter branch has a clear open fix candidate, but the remaining requests cross doctor UX, service supervision, browser/CDP isolation, and security handling, so automation should not choose the product scope alone.

options.title: Land and split scope
options.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move remaining SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime work into narrower issues if they still reproduce.

options.title: Keep umbrella tracker
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker for the full cascade, accepting that it needs manual scoping before more repair work starts.

options.title: Close after jitter only
options.body: Treat the jitter migration as the only actionable repo bug here and ask for new reports if the other symptoms still reproduce on current main.

recommendation.title: Land and split scope
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR for the boolean jitter migration and move remaining SecretRef/CDP/multi-runtime work into narrower issues if they still reproduce.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the visible repository member who handled the security-sensitive part of this issue discussion.
